payload.reason: The dataset was collected from Tatoeba and Common Voice, utilizing community contributions and validation processes.

claims.text: The dataset was constructed from Tatoeba (TT) by collecting (speech, transcript, English translation) triplets for five languages, filtering out samples with broken URLs or non-CC licensed speech.
Common Voice data was collected through crowdsourcing, where contributors recorded voice clips from a bank of donated sentences, with each clip validated by at least two users.
Validated transcripts from Common Voice were sent to professional translators for translation, ensuring quality and accuracy in the dataset.
